messages:
Amelia Chen: Quick game — only one-liners for the next 10 messages. I'll go: 'My laptop is on a seafood diet — it sees food and installs updates.'
Miguel Rivera: 'Debugging: turning coffee into code comments.' :coffee:
Priya Nair: 'Meetings: where minutes are kept and hours are lost.' :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Zoe Patel: 'Staging went down so I went up (to the snack table).' :cookie:
Connor O'Neill: Huge kudos to @Zoe Patel for the staging save yesterday — pulled an all-star fix. :trophy:
kudos-bot: Kudos recorded: Zoe Patel (+1) — "Staging hero". :sparkles:
Zoe Patel: thanks y'all, team effort honestly :heart:
Amelia Chen: switching gears: quick poll — name the new lounge plant. Options: 1) Fernando 2) Leafy McLeaf 3) Sir Photosynth. Reply with :one: :two: or :three:.
Miguel Rivera: :two: (Leafy McLeaf)
Priya Nair: :three: for the vibes
Connor O'Neill: :one: Fernandito is my vote
Zoe Patel: :two: funny and adorable
deploy-bot: FYI: office network patch tonight 22:00 UTC — printers may be unavailable for ~15 minutes. :wrench:
Amelia Chen: final one-liner to close the thread: 'If the plant survives my care, we deserve a raise.' :seedling:
